pub struct ResolveRequest
  capability: String
  contracts: Vec<String>
  guarantees: Vec<String>
  scope: Scope
pub struct ServiceReference
  provider: String
  capability: String
  contract: String
  guarantees: Vec<String>
  scope: Scope
  transport: String
  endpoint: String
pub struct ResolveResult
  status: ResolutionStatus
  reference: Option<ServiceReference>
pub struct BootstrapObservation
  state: BootstrapState
  detail: String
pub struct CapabilityObservation
  request: ResolveRequest
  result: Option<ResolveResult>
pub struct RuntimeObservation
  bootstrap: BootstrapObservation
  capabilities: Vec<CapabilityObservation>
pub struct CallerAttribute
  attribute: String
  proof: String
  ceiling: String
pub struct CallerObservation
  outcome: CallerOutcome
  mechanism: String
  account: String
  program: String
  pid: i64
  attributes: Vec<CallerAttribute>
  platform: String
  transport: String
  bindable: bool
  stronger: String
pub struct ServiceState
  contract: String
  readiness: ServiceReadiness
  why: String
  guarantees: Vec<String>
  capabilities: BTreeMap<String, String>
pub struct Description
  outcome: DescriptionOutcome

  version: String
  services: Vec<ServiceState>
pub struct RemoteTrust
  server_name: String
  roots: String
  certificate: String

  credential: String
pub struct Declaration

  contracts: Vec<String>
  guarantees: Vec<String>
  resources: Vec<String>
  activation: Activation
  remote: Option<RemoteTrust>
  models: Vec<String>
pub struct DeclarationState
  declaration: Declaration
  declared_by: String
  declared_unix_ms: i64
  readiness: DeclarationReadiness
  why: String
  restarts: i64
  described: Vec<ServiceState>
  accepted: Vec<String>

  outcome: DeclarationListOutcome

pub struct DeclarationChange
  outcome: DeclarationEditOutcome
  revision: String
  reason: String
pub struct DeclarationObservation
  outcome: DeclarationListOutcome

  name: String
  protocol: String
  contract: String

  readiness: ApplicationInterface

  start_guidance: String

pub struct ApplicationContext
  name: String

  revision: String

  contexts: Vec<ApplicationContext>
  lease_ms: i64

  instances: Vec<ApplicationInstance>
  scope: Scope
pub struct ApplicationChange
  outcome: ApplicationOutcome

pub struct ApplicationPage

pub struct ApplicationActivationResult
  outcome: ApplicationActivationOutcome
  instance: String
  started: bool
  reason: String

pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<ResolveResult, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait Resolver
  type Error
  fn resolve(&self, request: ResolveRequest) -> Result<ResolveResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ResolverClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Caller
  type Error
  fn observe(&self) -> Result<CallerObservation, Self::Error>
pub struct CallerClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Endpoint
  type Error
  fn describe(&self) -> Result<Description, Self::Error>
pub struct EndpointClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Registry
  type Error
  fn declarations(&self) -> Result<DeclarationList, Self::Error>
  fn declare(&self, expected_revision: String, declaration: Declaration) -> Result<DeclarationChange, Self::Error>
  fn withdraw(&self, expected_revision: String, name: String) -> Result<DeclarationChange, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, cursor: String, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<DeclarationObservation, Self::Error>
pub struct RegistryClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait Applications
  type Error
  fn register(&self, descriptor: ApplicationDescriptor) -> Result<ApplicationChange, Self::Error>
  fn remove(&self, application: String) -> Result<ApplicationChange, Self::Error>
  fn announce(&self, presence: ApplicationPresence) -> Result<ApplicationChange, Self::Error>
  fn withdraw(&self, application: String, instance: String) -> Result<ApplicationChange, Self::Error>
  fn observe(&self, cursor: String, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<ApplicationPage, Self::Error>
  fn activate(&self, application: String) -> Result<ApplicationActivationResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ApplicationsClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
